_comment: Webcam Recorder – startup configuration. All fields are optional; missing keys fall back to built-in defaults.
_backend_comment: OpenCV capture backend: auto (v4l2 on Linux, dshow on Windows), v4l2, dshow, msmf or any.
_fourcc_comment: Pixel format requested from the camera. The Arducam B0278 (IMX477) only supports MJPG. USB 2.0 effectively requires MJPG at 1080p and above (YUYV is too bandwidth-hungry).
_encoder_comment: ffmpeg output options placed between the raw input and the segment muxer. A keyframe interval (-g) of ~2x framerate is appended automatically if absent. Pi hardware-encode alternative: ["-c:v", "h264_v4l2m2m", "-b:v", "8M"].

controls._comment: V4L2/UVC control names, applied in listed order via `v4l2-ctl -c name=value`. Full control set of the Arducam B0278 (IMX477 HQ camera): brightness(-64..64), contrast(0..64), saturation(0..128), hue(-40..40), white_balance_automatic(0/1), gamma(72..500), gain(0..100), power_line_frequency(0=disabled, 1=50Hz, 2=60Hz), white_balance_temperature(2800..6500, only when auto WB off), sharpness(0..6), backlight_compensation(0..2), auto_exposure(1=manual, 3=aperture priority), exposure_time_absolute(1..5000 in 0.1 ms units = 0.1..500 ms, only when auto_exposure=1 is set first), exposure_dynamic_framerate(0/1). Inspect on device with: v4l2-ctl -d /dev/video0 --list-ctrls
